descriptor.name: Gdańsk municipal EGiB cadastral parcel polygons
descriptor.scope: Municipal parcel layer; frozen three-parcel local sample near the unchanged WUP point. No citywide completeness claim.
descriptor.licenceNote: Anonymous metadata and prior bounded safe parcel access documented; reuse licence and currentness not independently established.

evidence: Frozen city-2093-gdansk.json and gdansk-service-review.json identify municipal EGiB custody, parcel type ms:dzialki, native ID_DZIALKI and three full cadastral parcel polygons near the Gdańsk WUP point.

First-party municipal GetCapabilities inspected on 2026-10-10 identifies the public service publisher as Urząd Miejski w Gdańsku and exposes ms:dzialki titled Działki; DescribeFeatureType confirms ID_DZIALKI and geometry. See evidence/source-inspection.json.
GUGiK EGiB documentation describes the cadastral registry, local-authority custody and national parcel identifiers: https://www.geoportal.gov.pl/pl/dane/ewidencja-gruntow-i-budynkow-egib/
